primary_question: Can a learned compact predictive partition over observable action/observation history reduce NLL against capacity-controlled, FIT-trained conventional controls on fresh public causal families?
scientific_character: SOURCE_ONLY_PUBLIC_DEV; no protected first-use, no unfamiliar independent source custody, no native Wingless/Yggdrasil claim
negative_records_preserved: O4 small positive HMM CPU-cost mismatch

families.A_PUBLIC_FEEDBACK_LATCH: latent 2-bit (s,t), update s ^= action_t AND t, t=action_t; noisy observed bit s with flip 0.12
families.B_THREE_STATE_ROTATOR: latent ternary 0,1,2, action 0 increments +1 and action1 increments +2 modulo 3, noisy observed bit of state==2 flip 0.12
families.NULL_PUBLIC_IID: next observations iid fair Bernoulli regardless of actions

inputs: Learner sees only o_t,a_t plus past public observation/action; predicts o_t+1. No hidden state labels, future events, episode source metadata or role used as features.
missing_history: zero padding at episode start, identical for all comparator classes

models.LEARNED_PREDICTIVE_PARTITION: Greedy supervised predictive decision tree over 6 binary public history features; each split selected from O7_TRAIN using smoothed Bernoulli next-bit NLL reduction with cost penalty; at most 8 leaves; min observations per child 64; split penalty=0.001 nats/observation. Freeze candidate capacities 2,4,8; select capacity exclusively on O7_SELECT; no DEV adjustment.
models.RANDOM_SPLIT_PARTITION: Matched greedy tree topology and identical capacity/fit samples, but select splits using deterministic SHA256 features ranking independent of targets; fit true Bernoulli outputs to leaves; select capacity only O7_SELECT.
models.FIXED_FIRST3_PARTITION: Fixed first three public binary features determine exactly at most 8 possible states; outputs fit on same O7_TRAIN.
models.FULL_SIX_FEATURE_COUNTS: Exact public six-bit table, Laplace+1 counts, 64 possible states; disclose higher capacity.
models.FITTED_LOGISTIC: Learn next-bit Bernoulli probabilities from all six public features with 20 epochs full-batch gradient, learning rate 0.3, zero init, L2 0.001, no developer tuning.
models.TWO_STATE_RNN_ADAM: Verbatim O4 two-state recurrent model implementation blob 3ab09e0b9b27a3404ddaf81fdc3c26cc87ba7a4c, 16 epochs Adam, starts 17/31, selected on O7_SELECT.
models.TWO_STATE_HMM_EM: Verbatim O4 2-state action HMM, 12 EM iterations, starts 17/31, selected on O7_SELECT.

selection: All trained on identical O7_TRAIN public episodes; only specified capacity/restart selection on O7_SELECT; O7_DEV cannot update a model.

metrics: NLL difference from best of ALL trained conventional comparators
learned state bytes, nodes and leaves
source digests of all three roles
decision.positive_requires: Both causal families gain over strongest trained comparator (positive) plus no misleading positive null; report actual values and no scientific GO regardless.
decision.ablation_requires: Learned partition versus random-topology equal capacity, and unsplit/control, to isolate supervised representation mechanism.
decision.cross_os: Every family/role SHA256 digest byte-identical Linux/Windows, all per-family model NLL within 1e-6.
decision.no_promotion: No protection/production/scientific GO from PUBLIC_DEV; no retuning frozen identity after O7_DEV; preserve all signed negatives and resource costs.

limits: max 96 TRAIN per family ×32 steps; no hidden label features
no paid API, no extra controller/queue, no live KTRADE/broker/D1 or CKB plane authority mutation
no changes to original O2–O6 results/protocols/branches
no first-use/FSA protected science until independently admitted
